Senior review finding [blocker] at line 342: Three defects cause typecheck and test failures in pages.test.tsx: (1) line 342 calls h.store.scheduleCapture(CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY) with 1 argument, but Store.scheduleCapture() takes 0 arguments (TS2554); (2) in AC-6 (line 454), exportScene({ type: 'png', config: { embedScene: true } }) calls HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.toBlob which in JSDOM produces an empty non-PNG blob that fails PNG chunk decoding and times out after 5000ms; (3) in AC-7 (line 516), container.querySelector('.search-menu input') returns null because SearchMenu renders its input under `.${CLASSES.SEARCH_MENU_INPUT_WRAPPER} input` (and ListItem calls HTMLElement.prototype.scrollIntoView which is undefined in JSDOM unless mocked).

Fix `packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Senior review finding [major] at line 1342: In exportToBlob, the async callback passed to canvas.toBlob awaits encodePngMetadata without a try/catch block, so any error thrown during PNG metadata encoding results in an unhandled promise rejection and leaves the exportToBlob Promise unsettled forever.
Fix: Wrap the PNG embedScene block and resolve(blob) inside canvas.toBlob's async callback in a try { ... } catch (error) { reject(error); } block so errors properly reject the returned promise.
